name: io.github.zedong-peng/tailnet-mcp
title: Tailnet MCP bridge
description: Reach an MCP server inside your Tailscale tailnet from an agent's sandbox, over stdio.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Keeps the node key, so the auth key is needed only once

packageArguments.name: -url
packageArguments.description: MCP endpoint inside the tailnet, e.g. https://server.tailnet.ts.net:8443/mcp

packageArguments.name: -hostname
packageArguments.description: Node name in the tailnet; a different one per server

environmentVariables.name: TS_AUTHKEY
environmentVariables.description: Tagged, pre-authorized auth key; only needed the first time
